debug-restoration.description: Restores all known dummied-out debug features: cutscene playback and stage unlocks through button combos on the title and stage select screens, and Round Select, Sound Test, Automatic Play, Expert Enemies, Change Difficulty and Frame Advance through combos on the pause menu (hold R, or L + R for Frame Advance). The full list of combos is on the patch's Planet Virtual Boy page.

rumble.description: Adds RetroOnyx Rumble Pack support to Bound High!.
rumble.name: Rumble Pack Support

save-support.description: Adventure of Chalvo saves the most recent password received or entered and defaults to Continue when one is saved. Score Attack!! and Pocket and Cushion save high scores and stage completion stats; their password system is removed entirely. Erase the save by pressing L + R + Left D-Pad Down + Right D-Pad Down on the title screen.
save-support.name: Save Support

german-translation.description: Adds German as a third language, translates all dialogue, menus, stage cards, name labels, the magic menu and the controller help. Works combined with VB Color.

rumble.description: Adds RetroOnyx Rumble Pack support to Galactic Pinball.

debug-camera.description: Restores a debug mode for adjusting the camera's stereoscopic settings. Hold Select between shots to open it. Left D-Pad Left/Right adjusts the Z axis, Left D-Pad Up/Down the depth, Right D-Pad Up/Down moves 2D elements like the minimap in or out of the screen, Right D-Pad Left/Right renders a new frame. Cancel exits. Not a perfect restoration: it can be opened once per shot, and its text draws over itself until a new frame is rendered.
debug-camera.name: Debug Camera

save-restoration.description: The US release had saving disabled in the ROM, with its SRAM check hard-coded to fail. This restores saving by porting the hardware check from the Japanese release; the rest of the save code was left intact. Saves can be erased from the in-game menu under "Individual Records". Can be combined with Debug Camera.
save-restoration.name: Save Restoration

brightness-cap-fix.description: Fixes a minor bug where the Brightness setting fails to save if it is set to maximum.
brightness-cap-fix.name: Brightness Cap Fix

all-hallows-eve.description: Mansion of Insmouse: All Hallows' Eve, a level hack replacing the game's levels with new ones.
all-hallows-eve.name: All Hallows' Eve

double-health-limit.description: Raises the health limit from 5 to 10. The HUD can only show 5. Can be combined with Max Starting Health.
double-health-limit.name: Double Health Limit

english-translation.description: English translation of Insmouse no Yakata.

mario-madness-edition.description: A level hack replacing all of the game's levels with ones resembling characters from the Mario universe.
mario-madness-edition.name: Mario Madness Edition

max-starting-health.description: Raises the starting health to 5. Can be combined with Double Health Limit.
max-starting-health.name: Max Starting Health

german-translation.description: Translates all editable text and some graphics to German. Includes Parasyte's Unlock Debug Cheats.

russian-translation.description: Translates the complete game to Russian, including all the graphics.
russian-translation.name: Russian Translation

save-support.description: Saves progress separately for all three characters on the Select Player screen and for entered passwords, and saves the difficulty with separate slots for normal and super difficulty. Adds a debug mode switch: hold Select while booting, and the title screen shows "DEBUG" while it is on. Enables the Japan-only sound test and fixes its Japanese text. Adds a secret character to the Select Player screen: hold L + R while cycling. Erase a character's save by pressing Left D-Pad Down four times while it is highlighted. To switch languages, hold L + R + Left D-Pad Left and press Start on the title screen.
save-support.name: Save Support

spanish-translation.description: Translates the dialogues to Spanish. Includes Parasyte's Unlock Debug Cheats.
spanish-translation.name: Spanish Translation

unlock-debug-cheats.description: Re-enables the debug cheats the programmers deactivated. On the title screen, with the Left D-Pad: Right ×7, Left, Right ×7 opens Floor Select; Up, Right, Down, Left three times opens Muteki (invincibility) Select; Up ×3, Down ×4 opens the Sound Test.
unlock-debug-cheats.name: Unlock Debug Cheats

chinese-translation.description: Translates all Japanese text in Jack Bros. to Chinese.
chinese-translation.name: Chinese Translation

controller-fix.description: Changes the controller layout to the Mario standard: A jumps, B throws, and run is on both triggers.
controller-fix.name: Controller Fix

save-support.description: Saves level progress, high scores and brightness. Replaces the level select capped at 40 with one offering every level reached so far, up to 99. Erase the save by pressing L + R + Left D-Pad Down + Right D-Pad Down on the title screen. The Button Swap variant also has the Controller Fix layout.
save-support.name: Save Support

save-support-button-swap.description: Save Support with the controls remapped closer to other Mario games, based on DogP's Controller Fix. Use instead of Save Support, not with it.
save-support-button-swap.name: Save Support (Button Swap)

multiplayer.description: Restores three multiplayer modes that were disabled, and partly unfinished, in the released game: P1 vs P2, P1/COM vs P2/COM, and P1/P2 vs COM/COM, which is buggy.
multiplayer.name: Multiplayer

save-support.description: Saves your name, character, ball weight and the League Leaders high scores. Erase the save by pressing L + R + Left D-Pad Down + Right D-Pad Down on the title screen.
save-support.name: Save Support

rumble.description: Adds RetroOnyx Rumble Pack support to Panic Bomber.

haptics.description: Prototype support for RetroOnyx's Rumble Pack: buzzes when energy levels change, and a little at boot.

infinite-shield.description: Gives your ship infinite shield energy.
infinite-shield.name: Infinite Shield

save-support.description: Saves the high score, which is not written while in debug mode, and every options screen setting: brightness, depth, control scheme and difficulty. Erase the save by pressing L + R + Left D-Pad Down + Right D-Pad Down on the title screen.

score-reset.description: This patch for Space Pinball, the Galactic Pinball prototype, resets the score to 0 when a new game is started.
score-reset.name: Score Reset

english-translation.description: A very accurate and complete English translation. Can be combined with Save Support.
english-translation.name: English Translation

save-support.description: Saves game progress and character upgrades at the end of each Area, with a Continue option on the main menu to load them, as well as high scores and every Config Mode option. Removes the forced delay on the warning screen, makes Start on the title screen open the main menu, and fixes an original bug that kept beaten high scores from moving down the list. Erase the save by pressing L + R + Left D-Pad Down + Right D-Pad Down on the title screen. Can be combined with the English Translation.

debug-menu-with-select.description: Hold Select while the game boots to open the debug menu; otherwise the game boots normally. The menu is the one Unlock Debug Menu opens. Use one of the two, not both.
debug-menu-with-select.name: Debug Menu with Select

unlock-debug-menu.description: Boots into the debug menu left over from a beta version: MUSIC and SE play the music and sound effects, and MAINFG jumps to other parts of the game, a level select of sorts. Values are hex, with "?" in place of F. Use instead of Debug Menu with Select, not with it.

vb-color.description: Colorizations follow the unofficial Mega Drive version by Plutiedev.

select-any-team.description: Lets you pick any team in the normal game, including the All Star and Galaxy teams, and the same team for both sides. Left and right now move to the previous or next team, wrapping only at the ends: go left from USA or right from Switzerland for the new teams. The COM selection square can appear at the top for some of them. Not available in the Pennant Race.
select-any-team.name: Select Any Team

the-crew.description: Renames the custom teams after the team behind acquiring the prototype and other Virtual Boy scene legends.
the-crew.name: The Crew Team Names

compatibility-fix.description:
Makes the demo run correctly on modern emulators and real hardware.

- Fixes a hang at boot caused by the demo never turning on the display or drawing.
- Fixes the column table never being set.
- Fixes the timing by counting drawing cycles instead of VIP status register changes.
- Fixes auto-skipping screens by reading the controller only after the hardware read has finished.
- Fixes the wavy bars on the title screen by updating the H-Bias animation once per frame and only after drawing has finished.
compatibility-fix.name: Restoration

select-any-team.description: Lets you pick any team in the normal game, including the All Star and Miracle teams, and the same team for both sides. Left and right now move to the previous or next team, wrapping only at the ends. The COM selection square can appear at the top for some of the new teams. Not available in the Pennant Race.
select-any-team.name: Select Any Team

save-support.description: Adds a saved high score, shown in the top left of the HUD, which is rearranged a little to fit it. Asks for auto-pause only at boot rather than after every game over, and silences the reminder noise when no button is pressed for a while. Erase the save by pressing L + R + Left D-Pad Down + Right D-Pad Down on the title screen.
save-support.name: Save Support

practice-track-selector.description: Adds a track selector to the rival selection screen to pick any track in Practice Mode: cycle with L and R, then confirm on the regular track selection screen that follows, or it reverts to a normally selectable track.
practice-track-selector.name: Practice Track Selector

rumble.description: Adds RetroOnyx Rumble Pack support, tied into the game's own collision and event logic: different effects for wall impacts, collisions with other racers, low power, Jet Zones, Rapid activation and crash-outs. Also includes a small hidden rumble debug mode for testing effects.
rumble.name: Rumble Pack Support

sound-test-menu.description: Replaces the Record option on the main menu with the Sound Test, and fixes its background settings so the whole menu is visible.
sound-test-menu.name: Sound Test Menu

about.immersion: A soft halo driven by the picture itself.

about.off: Every frame as the game draws it.

frameBlending.description: Mix adjacent frames to emulate human persistence of vision as it works on a real Virtual Boy.
frameBlending.title: Frame Blending

gamepadRumbleIntensity.description: How strongly to play a game's rumble effects on your controller when no Rumble Pack is connected, in percent of what the controller can do; 0 turns it off. An approximation: the Rumble Pack's effects have lengths and shapes of their own that the protocol does not carry, so each one becomes a short pulse on the pad.

hardwareMode.description: Which console VUEPort emulates. Auto selects VB Color for ROMs marked Enhanced (80) or VBC Only (C0), and original Virtual Boy otherwise.
hardwareMode.title: Hardware Mode

mirrorSpinUp.description: Faithfully emulate how a real VB's mirror spin-up causes the picture to sway into place as the mirrors settle.
mirrorSpinUp.title: Mirror Spin-Up

mirrorSpinUpDelay.description: Keep the screen dark for the 4 seconds a real VB takes before its mirrors show a picture, rather than for a moment.
mirrorSpinUpDelay.title: Spin-Up Delay

palette.description: Colors the built-in emulator shows the four display brightness levels in, in every rendering mode but Anaglyph. Can be one of the built-in palettes or, as "custom:<name>", one defined in Custom Color Palettes.
palette.title: Color Palette

player2SameControls.description: Whether the second emulator of a link session answers to the same keys as the first. Turn this off to map a separate set of keys for player 2.
player2SameControls.title: Player 2 Uses Player 1 Controls

renderingMode.description: How the built-in emulator presents the two eyes. The colors each mode is shown in are configured separately.
renderingMode.title: Rendering Mode

retroAchievementsEnabled.description: Connect to RetroAchievements while playing, so a game that has an achievement set tracks your progress through it and unlocks achievements as you earn them. Needs an account, which is entered on the Achievements settings page.
retroAchievementsEnabled.title: RetroAchievements

retroAchievementsHardcore.description: Play for hardcore achievements: cheats, macros, patches, save-state loading, rewind and Debug mode are disabled while this is on. Turning it on restarts the ROM. Hardcore unlocks can not be credited until RetroAchievements approves the VUEPort client, but the restrictions apply now.
retroAchievementsHardcore.title: RetroAchievements Hardcore Mode

rewindBufferSize.description: Maximum memory in MB the rewind history may use. Only what changes between steps is stored, and how much that is depends heavily on the game: at a granularity of 1, 256 MB hold anywhere from about half a minute for games that change a lot every frame to more than half an hour, with many games between five and ten minutes.
rewindBufferSize.title: Rewind Buffer Size

rewindGranularity.description: Frames per rewind step, which is also how far Shift moves in the filmstrip. Coarser steps make the same memory last longer, though far from proportionally: depending on the game, about 1.2 to 3 times as long at 4 and 1.7 to 7 times at 8.
rewindGranularity.title: Rewind Granularity

screenshotFrameBlending.description: Mix adjacent frames to emulate human persistence of vision as it works on a real Virtual Boy

sramInit.description: What a save file is filled with before a game has written to it.

sramWindow.description: How much save RAM a cartridge answers on. Save files are trimmed to what a game writes either way.

stereoDepth.description: The stereoscopic depth of the screen, in percent, where 100% is the depth of the real console. Takes effect from the next game frame.

suspendResumeStart.title: Opening a Suspended Game

swapEyes.description: Switch left and right eyes in the 3D rendering modes: Anaglyph, Side by Side, CyberScope and the interleaved ones. Turn this on if the picture looks inside out, e.g. for glasses with the colors the other way round or a cross-eyed side-by-side view.
